sample_size_calculation.value: Sample size was calculated a priori in G*Power for a one-way ANOVA with fixed effects (omnibus test). Assuming a large effect size (f = 1.0), α = 0.05, 80% power, and five independent groups, a total of 20 participants was required. Under these parameters, the noncentrality parameter (λ) was 20.00, the critical F-value was 3.06 (df₁ = 4; df₂ = 15), and the achieved power was 0.88.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all patients had moderate to severe ARDS by Berlin definition. non_obese_population: mean BMI 23.62 kg/m2. timing_subgroup unclear: measurements performed at study enrolment with no interval from intubation/ICU admission/ARDS onset reported. ptp_target_subgroups: Ptp_ee_direct ≥ 0 cmH2O target coded as absolute_zero_end_expiratory_ptp; Ptp_ei_derived ≤ 25 cmH2O coded as elastance_derived; the study also applies best-compliance and EIT strategies (other) but these are not esophageal-Ptp targets. No mortality reported, so no is_longest_reported_mortality entry exists.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Checked against all clusters in COHORTS.md: single centre Ramathibodi Hospital, Bangkok, Thailand; enrolment June 2020 to April 2021; no trial registration number stated; no shared cohort with epvent1, epvent2, mannheim_boesing, mgh_lung_rescue, or angers. Concluded no overlap.
unclear_items: design.randomised: null — the order of conditions was not randomised; the five OP values were derived post hoc from a single decremental PEEP trial, so sequence_position was left null for all conditions.
population.n_enrolled: coded 26 (patients undergoing balloon insertion per Figure 1) rather than 21; the paper uses 'included' for both 26 eligible and 21 analysed.
feasibility.n_placement_successful: inferred as 26 from the flow chart listing 'Esophageal balloon insertion and monitoring' for all N=26; no explicit statement of placement success rate.

outcomes[transpulmonary_pressure Ptp_ee_direct at OP].data[ptp_ee_direct_ge0]: the text reports 'a median Ptp_ee_direct of 0.4 cm H₂O (0.6, 1.0)' — the IQR low bound exceeds the median, likely a typo (possibly 0.4 (−0.6, 1.0) or similar); recorded verbatim.

outcomes[ventilator_settings].paired_effects: three pairwise p-values (0.009, 0.039, 0.021) appear only as brackets in Figure 2 without labelled pairs in the caption; contrast direction could not be assigned.

eligibility.balloon_guided_peep_titration: coded yes because esophageal-pressure criteria determined optimal PEEP within the study protocol; however, the Limitations state 'final PEEP settings were determined by the attending physicians', so the Ptp-guided settings were experimental rather than delivered clinical management.
population.covid19_population: not_reported; enrolment 2020–2021 but no COVID data given.

intervention.timing: reference_event set to enrolment by construction; no timing relative to intubation or ARDS onset reported.

Figure 5: Ptp_ee_direct and median lung collapse at each PEEP level 20–8 cmH2O

extraction_flags.general_notes: The Ptp_ee_direct associated with zero lung collapse on EIT was 5.15 cm H₂O (1.90, 6.70) (Results, 5.3, para 2) — no dedicated schema field; relevant to Ptp target heterogeneity. Median Ecw/Ers was 0.18 (0.11, 0.27); EL/ERS and ECW/ERS constant during titration (p = 0.99, 0.99). Median EIT overdistension across all measurements (147 measurements from 21 patients) was 12% (2, 23). Four patients excluded for hemodynamic instability during RM — RM-related, not balloon-related, so not recorded as balloon complications. No clinical outcomes (mortality, VFD, LOS) reported; the study explicitly states it 'was not designed to assess clinical outcomes'.
